captured_note: The inventory (docs/INVENTORY.md) classifies VAR as submodule+adapter, MIT.
note: The model is the pinned upstream under third_party/var, imported and never copied here (DESIGN section 1). Pinned DIRECTLY, no fork: VAR's model runs on a CPU or a GPU unmodified -- it has no hardcoded device (the only torch.cuda.amp.autocast on the model path is enabled=False, a no-op on a CPU) -- so it needs no patch. This is DESIGN's submodule+adapter case, unlike mar, whose model forced a submodule+patch fork. The upstream DDP/AMP trainer (trainer.py, dist.py, the bfloat16 autocast) is not used; train_pretrain_var.py owns a single-process, device-resolved loop over the model's own forward.
encoder: encoder.pt is the representation side of VAR: the token embedding (word_embed), class and positional and level embeddings, and the transformer blocks. The generative output head (head, head_nm) is excluded, so encoder.pt is the representation network.
linear_eval: The linear_eval stage answers CONTRACT section 7 for VAR by following the lab's ARSSL harness: it probes VAR's VQVAE TOKENISER (the encoder's continuous features, global-average-pooled to Cvae dims), NOT the VAR transformer that step 1 trains, and so it reads no encoder.pt. The measured accuracy therefore describes the fixed, pretrained tokeniser rather than VAR's learned representation. A real run needs the tokeniser weights (tokenizer_artifact below, fetched and hash-verified by bin/fetch-weights.py); the hermetic smoke builds a random VQVAE, so its number is meaningless and only the pipeline is exercised. See docs/EVAL_DOWNLOAD.md.

tokenizer_artifact.name: VAR VQVAE tokeniser (vae_ch160v4096z32)
tokenizer_artifact.sha256_source: the git-lfs pointer at https://huggingface.co/FoundationVision/var/raw/main/vae_ch160v4096z32.pth (its oid sha256), confirmed on 2026-08-05 by a full download whose bytes bin/fetch-weights.py hashed to this value, after which the checkpoint loaded into build_vqvae with strict=True

rewritten_during_the_port: the device is resolved (resolve_device) instead of reached through dist.py/AMP
main() split into build_parser()/run(args, config) returning the cross-entropy loss and epoch count
the run is seeded through make_deterministic (python, numpy, torch)

the training loop drops the upstream DDP/AMP machinery so the same step runs on a CPU or a GPU unchanged; flash/fused attention are forced off so a run does not depend on whether flash-attention is installed
DATA_ROOT is the dataset root; step-1 reads its train/ subdirectory (unified data-root convention via adapterlib.dataset_split_dir).
